class.name: VoxelGenerator
class.brief_description: Main voxel terrain generator using marching cubes algorithm.
class.description:
VoxelGenerator is the primary class for procedural voxel terrain generation. It uses the marching cubes algorithm to create smooth terrain meshes from density fields.
Features include: - Per-chunk mesh generation for efficient rendering - Distance-based LOD system - Heightmap-first optimization mode - Async generation with progress signals - Dirty chunk system for incremental updates

method.name: generate
method.description: Generates the entire voxel terrain synchronously. This will block the main thread until complete. For large worlds, consider using [method generate_async] instead.

method.name: generate_async
method.description: Generates the voxel terrain asynchronously using worker threads. Emits [signal generation_progress] periodically and [signal generation_complete] when finished.

method.name: cancel_generation
method.description: Cancels any in-progress async generation. Safe to call even if no generation is running.

method.name: is_generating
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if async generation is currently in progress.

method.name: calculate_chunk_lod
method.description: Calculates the appropriate LOD level for a chunk based on its distance from [member lod_reference_position]. Returns 0 (highest detail) to 7 (lowest detail).

method.name: get_chunk_center_world_position
method.description: Returns the world-space center position of the chunk at the given index.

method.name: update_chunks_lod
method.description: Recalculates LOD levels for all chunks based on distance from [member lod_reference_position]. Returns the number of chunks that need regeneration due to LOD changes. Call [method regenerate_dirty_chunks] after this to apply the changes.

method.name: mark_chunk_dirty
method.description: Marks a chunk as needing regeneration. Use with [method regenerate_dirty_chunks] for incremental updates.

method.name: regenerate_dirty_chunks
method.description: Regenerates all chunks that have been marked dirty via [method mark_chunk_dirty] or [method update_chunks_lod].

method.name: reset_lod_distances_to_default
method.description: Resets [member lod_distances] to default values calculated from [member chunk_size] and [member lod_distance_multiplier].

method.name: debug_print_state
method.description: Prints comprehensive debug information about the generator's current state to the output console.

members.member: The size of the world in chunks. Each axis can be 1-100 chunks.
The size of each chunk in voxels per axis. Valid range: 8-64.
The number of marching cubes samples per voxel. Higher values create smoother terrain but increase generation time exponentially.

The generation algorithm to use: - [code]0[/code] (VOXELS_FIRST): Full 3D marching cubes. Most accurate but slower. - [code]1[/code] (HEIGHTMAP_FIRST): Optimized for terrain. Only processes voxels near the surface.
In HEIGHTMAP_FIRST mode, the vertical distance above and below the terrain surface to process. Larger values handle steeper terrain but are slower.
Global LOD level (0-7). Higher values reduce detail. LOD N uses resolution/(2^N) effective samples.
When enabled, each chunk's LOD is calculated based on distance from [member lod_reference_position].
The position used for distance-based LOD calculations. Typically set to the camera or player position.
Distance thresholds for LOD levels 0-7. Chunks closer than [code]lod_distances[N][/code] use LOD N or lower.
Multiplier for default LOD distance calculations. Higher values extend detail further from the reference position.
When enabled, chunks are colored by their LOD level (green=LOD 0, red=LOD 7) for debugging.
The noise generator used for base terrain height. Uses 2D noise sampling.
The noise generator used for 3D rocky detail. Combined with terrain noise based on [member rock_influence].
Base terrain height offset in world units.
Maximum height variation from noise. Terrain ranges from [code]terrain_height - amplitude[/code] to [code]terrain_height + amplitude[/code].
How much the 3D detail noise affects the terrain (0.0-1.0). Higher values create more rocky, overhanging terrain.
The density threshold for the marching cubes algorithm. Values below cutoff are solid, above are air.
When enabled, terrain regenerates automatically when properties change.
Enables debug logging output.
Debug output detail level (0-3). Higher values show more detailed logging.

signal.name: chunk_ready
signal.description: Emitted when a chunk's mesh has been applied during async generation.

signal.name: generation_progress
signal.description: Emitted periodically during async generation to report progress.

signal.name: generation_complete
signal.description: Emitted when async generation has finished.
